bias.zh: 中性偏空 · 守住 $252 支撑

read.en: Bloom Energy edged up 0.4% on Oct 13 to $263.45 after an intraday drop to $248.35. It is below its 5-day ($274.1), 10-day ($279.7) and 30-day ($268.8) averages, and above the 100-day ($254.0, now edging lower) and 200-day ($214.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($299), and RSI is 48.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 10月13日盘中跌至 $248.35 后回升，小涨 0.4% 收于 $263.45。股价位于 5 日（$274.1）、10 日（$279.7）和 30 日均线（$268.8）下方，并在 100 日（$254.0，开始小幅下行）和 200 日均线（$214.1）上方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$299），RSI 为 48。

read.en: The $252 support (Sep 24 low and 100-day average) was breached intraday but held on the close, keeping the pullback inside the range. Resistance is $269 (30-day average), then $274–280 (5 and 10-day averages) and $303 (Sep 29 and Oct 6 highs). Below $248 (Oct 13 low), the next support is $229 (June pivot).
read.zh: $252 支撑（9月24日低点及 100 日均线）盘中被跌破，但收盘守住，回调仍在区间之内。阻力为 $269（30 日均线），其次 $274–280（5 日和 10 日均线）及 $303（9月29日和 10月6日高点）。若跌破 $248（10月13日低点），下一支撑为 $229（6月转折点）。

r.en: Sep 29 and Oct 6 highs; capped since May
r.zh: 9月29日及10月6日高点；5月以来压力
